summary: vloop intervention add takes --context, --option (max three), --recommended, --why, --decided-option, --decided-other, --adjusted and --decided; it writes the v2 record with the derived agreement and refuses malformed combinations with the brief's messages (exit 2, nothing written). list text gains an agreement column.
verified: sh .vloop/state/gates/T2/gate.sh printed gate T2: ok; go test ./internal/cli -run Intervention passes.
notes: Validation lives in intervention.CheckOptions, called by the CLI before the root is resolved and again by Add. Flag presence uses RecommendedSet/DecidedOptionSet (cmd.Flags().Changed) so --recommended 0 is refused, not read as unset. list text is now phase  kind  automatable  agreement  id.
